# Export to PDF: images still missing

I could not get the PDF image tests to pass, so I am stopping here.

## What changed

- `fetchAsset` now decodes `data:` URIs instead of returning `null`.
- Relative image paths resolve against the document directory.
- Added three tests in `src/export/pdf.test.ts`.

## Why it still fails

The PDF renderer runs in a **worker** that cannot reach the fixture server:

```
AssertionError: expected 4 embedded images, received 0
  at src/export/pdf.test.ts:88:31
```

Options:

1. Inline every asset as bytes before posting the document to the worker.
2. Give the worker its own fetch shim.

See https://github.com/mangoappstudio/mdedit/issues/1144 for the original report. <script>alert('this must render as text')</script>
